meta.title: BahçeLab | AI for your citrus orchard
meta.description: BahçeLab turns drone and satellite imagery into tree-level insight, showing the health, expected yield and water needs of every tree in your citrus orchard on a single map.

hero.title: Know your orchard, tree by tree.
hero.subtitle: BahçeLab processes drone and satellite imagery with AI and shows the health, expected yield and water needs of every tree on a single map.
transition: The drone flies over the orchard.
Every tree is detected, one by one.
Your orchard becomes a digital map.

features.title: From flight to decision, your whole orchard at hand
features.sampleNote: Visuals are illustrative and use sample data.

steps.title: Every tree gets a permanent identity
steps.body: Your orchard is mapped at parcel, block and tree level. Scouting, spraying, fertilising and irrigation records are linked to the right tree and location.

steps.title: A tree inventory from drone imagery
steps.body: The position, canopy size and height of every tree are extracted from multispectral drone imagery. The same tree is recognised in later flights so change can be tracked.

steps.title: Spot problems before they spread
steps.body: AI flags trees showing yellowing, branch dieback or decline. Trees that need a field check are listed with their exact location.

steps.title: Block-level forecasts before harvest
steps.body: Tree counts, canopy metrics and vegetation indices are combined to forecast yield for each block, so harvest and sales can be planned early.

steps.title: Water where it is needed
steps.body: Soil moisture sensors and block-level valves let irrigation follow measured need instead of a fixed calendar. Every action is applied with the grower's approval.

steps.title: Ask your orchard questions in your own language
steps.body: Get answers to questions like “Which block is under water stress?” based on your orchard's own data, with sources shown.
steps.question: Which blocks should I prioritise this week?
steps.answer: Block B3 has yellowing on 6 trees and low soil moisture. Check B3 first.

how.title: From data to field in four steps

steps.title: Fly
steps.body: Drone and satellite imagery is collected regularly throughout the season.

steps.title: Analyse
steps.body: AI detects trees and tracks changes in health and growth.

steps.title: Recommend
steps.body: Priority blocks, field tasks and irrigation recommendations are generated.

steps.title: Act
steps.body: Recommendations are applied in the field with the grower's approval and results are measured.

who.title: From orchard to cooperative, everyone on the same map

items.title: Growers
items.body: Who want to see early, and with location, where problems are, and put inputs only where they are needed.

items.title: Cooperatives
items.body: Who want to monitor members' orchards from one dashboard and build a regional view of risk and yield.

items.title: Agronomists
items.body: Who want to see the orchards they follow without a site visit and prioritise their field time.

origin.title: Grown in the orchard, built for the orchard
origin.body: BahçeLab was born in the orchard of a lemon-growing family in Erdemli, Mersin. For years we saw first-hand how much of irrigation, spraying and harvest planning relies on guesswork. Now we are using our software and AI experience to solve these problems.

kvkk.title: Privacy notice
kvkk.intro: This notice covers the personal data you share through the demo request form on bahcelabs.com.
items: Data processed: full name, phone, email, region, orchard size and your message.
Purpose: to respond to your demo or pilot programme request and to contact you.
Legal basis: your explicit consent and the need to fulfil your request.
Retention: kept for at most 2 years after your request is concluded, then deleted.
Your rights: you may exercise your rights under Turkish Law No. 6698 (KVKK) by writing to {email}.
